person: Ana Fifita, veterinary nurse at Greywater Veterinary Hospital, lives in Kereru Heights, Auckland; keeps her horse Biscuit at Ridgeback Farm Livery and plays WA for the Kauri Comets netball team

mail.subject: I'm turning 30!
mail.body: Kia ora team! I'm turning 30 and having a BBQ at ours, 22 Kingfisher Rise, three weeks from today from 3pm till late. Bring a salad and your togs, the pool is finally clean. A few of you asked about a present: we're all chipping in for a kayak voucher, Liam is collecting, his account details are in the group chat. x Rosa

mail.subject: Order BB-20931 confirmed
mail.body: Thanks Ana. Order BB-20931: Comfort-Curve dressage girth (size 26) $129.00, mesh fly veil (cob) $48.50, shipping $12.00. Total $189.50 paid by card. We'll email you when it ships.

mail.subject: Roster for the next fortnight
mail.body: Hi team, roster for the next fortnight is up on the staffroom board. Ana, you're mostly on earlies Monday and Wednesday and a late on Thursdays. Tomasi has swapped his Friday late with Grace. Shout if anything looks wrong. Bronwyn

mail.subject: Season fees
mail.body: Hey Comets, season fees are $65 each this year because court hire went up. Please pay by the end of next week to the team account (details in the group chat) with your name as the reference. Cheers, Jun (treasurer)

mail.subject: Biscuit's policy renewal
mail.body: Kia ora Ana, Biscuit's equine policy KPE-448812 renews in 20 days. Your new premium is $54.20 a month (up from $49.80) and your excess stays at $250 per claim. No action is needed if you'd like to continue cover.

mail.subject: Great training + Round 7
mail.body: Great work tonight team. Round 7 is next week against Harbour Hawks. Warm-up is at 6:00 sharp, no excuses. Ana, you're on bib duty for Round 7 so please bring them washed. Moana

mail.subject: Biscuit: annual vaccinations and dental
mail.body: Hi Ana, confirming Biscuit for his annual flu and tetanus booster and a dental exam two weeks from today at Ridgeback Farm. He'll probably need light sedation for the rasp, so please keep him off hard feed for two hours beforehand, and have his passport ready so I can sign the vaccination page. Estimated fee $240 incl. GST, payable on the day. Ingrid, Hillcrest Equine Practice

mail.subject: Sunday lunch
mail.body: Ana darling, lunch at mine on Sunday after next. Can you bring the pavlova? Your aunty Seini is coming down. And don't forget Sione's birthday is the Monday after. Love Mum

mail.subject: Booking TF-3382 confirmed
mail.body: Hi Ana, your two-horse float is booked for two weeks from this Saturday. Pick up from our yard at 14 Totara Gully Road from 6:30am and return by 7pm. Day hire $120, plus a $200 bond refunded on return. Booking ref TF-3382.

mail.subject: A parcel is waiting for you
mail.body: A parcel is waiting for you at Kereru Heights Post Shop. Collection code 5521. Please bring photo ID. We'll hold it for 10 days before returning it to the sender.

mail.subject: Float share for Kahikatea?
mail.body: Hey! Saw on the yard board you've booked a float for the Kahikatea dressage day. Could Pepper and I share? Happy to split it, $40 from me towards hire and fuel. Jo

mail.subject: Entry confirmed: Summer Dressage Day
mail.body: Thank you for entering Summer Dressage Day, two weeks from tomorrow. Rider: Ana Fifita. Horse: Ridgeback Biscuit. Classes: Prelim 3 and Prelim 12. Rider number 47. Entry fee $85 paid. Draw times will be emailed two days before the event. Stabling: not booked.

mail.subject: Your order has shipped
mail.body: Order BB-20931 is on its way with Swiftfern Couriers, tracking SF88213450NZ. Estimated delivery: next Friday.

mail.subject: End of season dinner: vote!
mail.body: Comets! End of season dinner is three weeks from tomorrow, Saturday night. Two options: Saffron Lane (set menu, $55 a head) or The Copper Kettle (a la carte, about $40). Reply with your vote by Wednesday please. P

mail.subject: Biscuit next Saturday
mail.body: Hi Ana, confirming Biscuit for next Saturday as we sorted on the phone. Front shoes reset and a hind trim, $95 cash or bank transfer. Please have him caught and in the yard 15 minutes before I arrive, dry legs if you can. Cheers, Lachlan

mail.subject: Order ready for collection
mail.body: Hi Ana, your order is ready: 4 x Steadyfoot Cool Mix 20kg at $35.50 = $142.00, paid. Collect from the back dock any time before we close next Saturday. Saturday hours are 8am to 1pm.

mail.subject: airport run?
mail.body: Sis can you drop me at the airport next Saturday? My flight's at 9:40 so I need to be there by 7:30. I'll shout you breakfast after!

mail.subject: Yard notice: arena resurfacing and worming
mail.body: Morning all. The arena will be closed for two days starting a week from tomorrow while the new surface goes down; the round pen stays open. Worming is a week today, I'll do everyone and add $18 to your invoice. And a heads up that hay goes up $2 a bale from next month. Gwen

mail.subject: bins + this weekend
mail.body: Hey, council has changed our bin day to Wednesday morning, so bins go out Tuesday night from now on. Also my mate Ravi is crashing on the couch Friday and Saturday, hope that's ok. J

mail.subject: Saturday lesson
mail.body: Hi Ana, a small change for this Saturday: my earlier client has moved, so can we start at 12 instead of 11? Same place, $70 as usual. We'll run through Prelim 12. H

mail.subject: Appointment reminder
mail.body: Hi Ana, this is a reminder of your check-up and clean with Dr Aiko Mori two weeks from tomorrow. The fee is $145. Please arrive 10 minutes early to update your health form. Reply C to confirm.

mail.subject: Registration confirmed: Anaesthesia Monitoring for Vet Nurses
mail.body: Kia ora Ana, you're registered for Anaesthesia Monitoring for Vet Nurses, two weeks from today. Bring your VNGA member number so we can record your CPD points (6 hours). Lunch is provided; let us know about dietary needs. Please park in Building C; the main car park is staff only.

mail.subject: WOF booking this Thursday
mail.body: Hi Ana, you're booked in for a WOF this Thursday. It's $69 and takes about 45 minutes; wait in the lounge or leave the keys with us. Just so you know, your registration also expires at the end of next month.

mail.subject: Thursday theatre list
mail.body: Ana, can you prep theatre for Muffin's cruciate repair on Thursday? First case at 1:30. Patient 44120, 38kg Labrador, fasted from midnight. I'd like the new multiparameter monitor set up for this one. Thanks, Kamal

mail.subject: Your power bill is ready
mail.body: Hi Ana, your latest power bill is $187.34. It's due in 10 days. Account number 30044871. You can pay online or by bank transfer.

mail.subject: Membership renewal
mail.body: Your VNGA membership (no. VNGA-30917) expires in four weeks. Renewal is $210 for the year, or $195 if you renew within the next fortnight. Your CPD log shows 14 of the 20 points needed for this cycle.

mail.subject: Re: airport run?
mail.body: Actually Uncle Tevita can take me on Saturday, sorry for the faff! Breakfast another time x

mail.subject: Cover the Saturday after next?
mail.body: Hi Ana, any chance you could cover an 8am to 1pm shift the Saturday after next? Grace is away. Let me know by Friday. B

mail.subject: lift on Friday?
mail.body: Can I grab a lift to the game on Friday? I'm five minutes from yours. I can drive next time.

mail.subject: Team for Friday
mail.body: Team for Friday: Priya C, Ana WA, Hana GA, Losa GS, Mia GK, Tara GD, Charlotte WD, Elif on the bench. Warm-up at 6:00. Next week we're on Court 2 against Tidewater Tuis.

mail.subject: Delivery update SF88213450NZ
mail.body: Your parcel from Bridle & Burr Saddlery is delayed at our South Hub depot and will now arrive on Monday. Sorry for the delay.

mail.subject: Biscuit next week
mail.body: Hi Ana, a quick note ahead of Biscuit's visit next week: please have him in a stable or small yard rather than out in the far paddock. Dr Solberg can also give the strangles vaccine on the day if you'd like it added, $45 extra.

mail.subject: Re: dinner vote, last call
mail.body: Votes so far: Saffron Lane 5, Copper Kettle 3. Still need Ana, Elif and Tara! Voting closes tonight.

mail.subject: Re: Float share for Kahikatea?
mail.body: Thanks for saying yes! I'll meet you at Topline at 6:30 on the day. Pepper's in Prelim 3 too so we can warm up together. I'll transfer the $40 after the show.

mail.subject: Item due soon
mail.body: The Quiet Paddock by M. Ellery is due back tomorrow. Someone has reserved it, so it can't be renewed.

mail.subject: Rosa's present
mail.body: Hey Ana, I've got 9 of us in for the kayak voucher so far at $30 each. Could you transfer by Monday? Keep it quiet, it's a surprise!

mail.subject: Umpire course places open
mail.body: Places are open for the Level 1 umpire course two weeks from Saturday, 9am to 3pm, $40. Register at the front desk.

mail.subject: December livery invoice
mail.body: Hi Ana, December invoice attached: full livery $680 plus worming $18, total $698. Due in two weeks as usual. Thanks! Gwen

mail.subject: swap?
mail.body: Hey Ana, could you swap your late next Thursday for my early on Friday next week? It's my daughter's prizegiving. Owe you one.

mail.subject: Save the date: Christmas party
mail.body: Save the date! The staff Christmas party is three weeks from this Friday at The Lantern Room, 7pm. Partners welcome. RSVP to Bronwyn by next Friday.
